## Product

The equipment notebook for your maintenance crew

Open the machine's notebook, find the right manual passage, ask a question, and record what fixed it.

One maintenance crew working on qualified machines and manuals.

## Proven claims

- We've tested Rockwell and Festo manuals so far, and we'll post our misses too.
- Web sign-in uses a magic link.

## Proven limits

- It's not a CMMS and doesn't replace yours. There's nothing to switch.
- It doesn't take PLC data and doesn't write work-order records.
- Mike can come onsite in Central Florida or work remote.

## Not on this site yet

- PLC connectivity, third-party maintenance-software integrations, autonomous workflows, and an any-manual promise are not offered today.
- Do not invent prices, provider names, documentation-chunk counts, or cited-answer guarantees.

## How to get a pilot

There is no self-serve checkout and no published price on this site.
Talk to Mike: mike@factorylm.com. See https://factorylm.com/buy.
